supersededRuns.reason: Desktop Firefox stopped in the existing late-series-save failure case before any write or new volume case. The Keeper-only layout stylesheet now uses automatic root scrolling so focus/form navigation settles immediately. No assertion, timeout, click forcing, retry or skip was changed. The earlier whole-clock hypothesis is not treated as a complete explanation because this case uses no clock override. The shell unlock reset also follows automatic scrolling instead of explicitly requesting a smooth animation.
